factual_claims.claim: A survey of 146 papers on AI bias in NLP reveals that most research lacks clear normative reasoning and consistent definitions of bias. Many papers fail to explain why the behaviors they label as 'bias' are harmful or to whom they cause harm. This lack of conceptual clarity leads to quantitative techniques that are often poorly matched to the stated motivations of the research.
factual_claims.claim_label: Lack of Normative Reasoning in AI Bias Research

factual_claims.claim: Part-of-speech taggers, language identification systems, and dependency parsers perform worse on text containing features associated with African-American English (AAE) compared to text without these features.
Toxicity detection systems score tweets containing features associated with African-American English (AAE) as more offensive than tweets without these features.
Extensive academic research exists documenting gender, race, and dialect bias in NLP systems, including sentiment analysis, coreference resolution, and hate speech detection.
